verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented bot protection (such as CAPTCHA), no rate limiting on auth endpoints, and no credential-stuffing or brute-force defenses for Supabase Auth. Password character requirements, refresh-token reuse detection and MFA are related security controls, but none of them is the attack protection this story asks for.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can rely on built-in protection against bots, credential stuffing, and brute-force attacks on the auth flows
